progress.description: Enables progress output during operations, corresponding to the -p/--progress command line flag.

sparse.description: Creates sparse files on export, corresponding to the -s/--sparse command line flag.

ignore_checksum.description: Only warns on failed checksums instead of failing the operation, corresponding to the -i/--ignore-checksum command line flag.

output_dir.description: The base directory for extracting .xva files or storing generated disk images.

input_dir.description: The base directory containing source .xva archives and ova.xml manifest files.
